message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **national long‑weekends** in Canada for 2023 (dates that create a 3‑day stretch of paid time off).  
*(Note: Some provinces have extra holidays that can add a fourth day.)*

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|---------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | **Feb 18–20** | Observed on Monday, Feb 20. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Apr 7–9** | Friday, Apr 7; the weekend follows. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **May 20–22** | Monday, May 22. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Jul 7–9** | Canada Day fell on Saturday; observed on Friday, Jul 7. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sep 2–4** | Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Oct 7–9** | Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed) | **Nov 10–12** | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday; observed on Friday, Nov 10. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Dec 23–25** | Monday, Dec 25. |

---

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Include Provincial Variations** – e.g., Family Day in Ontario is on Feb 20, but in Manitoba it’s on the third Monday of February (Feb 20 in 2023).  
2. **Observance Rules** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, most provinces observe it on the preceding Friday (or following Monday).  
3. **Add Custom Holidays** – Some provinces have unique holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Juneteenth in BC) that can create extra long weekends.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial list or any other details!
